conclusions.text: All 17 Atlas source records combine a RESOLVE 2017 ecological feature reference with exactly one retained TCD ADM2 department predecessor; the current source_role and selection_reason describe the predecessor as though it were the selected whole-unit delineation.

The fragment footprints have high measured spatial overlap with the pinned admin×ecoregion inputs and almost wholly span each predecessor in aggregate, but measurements are not proof of the original clipping recipe, a legally authoritative boundary or ecological completeness.

The 2017 ADM1 parent candidate screen is time-mismatched with the 2019 TCD ADM2 source and licensed separately under ODbL 1.0; parent names and overlap ratios are not a same-vintage authoritative crosswalk.
The intended current legal department roster, source-complete ecological partition and suitability of these fragments as Atlas subdivisions remain unresolved.

methods.description: Join the exact 17 Atlas source_id and source_member_ids to retained 2017 RESOLVE ECO_ID features and 2019 OCHA TCD ADM2 features; inspect feature names, biome/license fields, captured source metadata, parent source level, provenance, exact pins and source vintage limits. Inspect same-tier neighboring ADM2 units in the retained source layer.

methods.description: Compute polygon topology/intersections for the 17 exact Atlas features, five RESOLVE features, six 2019 TCD ADM2 units and retained 2017 ADM1 parent candidates; use explicit in-memory make_valid clones only for invalid original ecological geometries; calculate areas via shared helper.
methods.units: m² and dimensionless area fractions; adjacent-unit shared-boundary screen in EPSG:4326 degrees
